about: What the content coverage audit flags as page hygiene: things a customer must never see on a page built from a quickstart. Read by content-coverage/lib/hygiene.mjs; whether a finding holds Publish is apps/tracy-web/src/lib/content-coverage/policy.json. Edit this file to tune a detector; no code change is needed, but bump TOOL_VERSION in lib/coverage-file.mjs when the audit then sees more.

reasons.includeHidden: A constant or placeholder hidden at one width shows at another (TPL_FOLLOW_US is d-none d-hd-inline), and a screen reader reads hidden attributes.
reasons.constantPrefixes: Joomla language keys are PREFIX_WORD_WORD; only keys in a page's visible text or a read attribute count, never the keys a page script carries (they are handed to JavaScript with their translation).
reasons.minConstantSegments: An upper-case token with an unknown prefix counts only with three or more parts (COM_FINDER_X), so a brand like ACME_CORP is left alone.
reasons.phpLevels: PHP prints these as 'Level: message in /path/file.php on line N'; only that whole shape counts, so prose that starts with 'Warning:' is left alone.
reasons.placeholderWords: A template field word left in upper case inside sentence case copy ('your first TITLE workout!') is a field never filled. A text that is all upper case is a real heading and is left alone, unless it is the word alone.
reasons.minLowercaseShare: Share of lower-case letters a text needs before an upper-case placeholder word inside it counts.
reasons.tokenPatterns: {contact.tel} and %sitename% are tokens a layout should have replaced; ((word)) is the JA ACM span syntax left raw.
